llm.summary: This is a straightforward code-review skill that reads relevant repository context and produces findings without modifying code or adding persistence.

dimensions.detail: The skill may read repository files broadly enough to understand a diff, including callers and tests, which is expected for code review but users should expect repository inspection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown SKILL.md with frontmatter metadata and no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or remote payload retrieval instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are review-focused and explicitly require concrete, verified findings; they do not ask the agent to override system policy, hide behavior, exfiltrate data, or run unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill states it lists findings and changes no code; it contains no persistence, privilege escalation, credential handling, background workers, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is quality review of code changes, and its instructions are limited to inspecting diffs, touched code, callers, tests, and documentation to produce a review report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a strict code-review assistant. It will inspect relevant code and project files to support its findings, but the artifact does not request write access, persistence, credentials, or automatic execution beyond producing a review report.
